title: 小別勝新婚
titleEn: Absence Makes the Heart Grow Fonder
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for Absence Makes the Heart Grow Fonder.

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: People may feel more affection for someone while they are apart and miss that person.
meaning.zh: 與在乎的人分開一段時間後，可能因為掛念而更珍惜對方。

formulas.formula: absence makes the heart grow fonder
formulas.highlight: absence makes the heart grow fonder

examples.en: While Cheng was away on placement, she looked forward to her weekly calls with her grandmother even more—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
examples.zh: 阿澄去外地實習後，反而更期待每週與祖母通話。
examples.highlight: absence makes the heart grow fonder

instructions.en: Choose the one sentence that keeps the situation’s facts and uses “absence makes the heart grow fonder” accurately.
instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「absence makes the heart grow fonder」的英文句子。

questions.answer: May missed her mother more while they were apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
